FIELDS.NAME: Home & Hearth Essentials
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Home & Hearth Essentials, we specialize in providing a wide range of high-quality kitchen and home accessories. Our operations focus on retail sales from our brick-and-mortar locations, offering a carefully curated selection of cookware, kitchen gadgets, utensils, and home decor items. We emphasize customer service, ensuring our staff is well-trained in product knowledge and safety standards to assist customers effectively. 

We do not engage in installation or repair services to avoid the complexities and risks associated with these operations, maintaining our commitment to providing a safe shopping environment. All inventory is sourced from certified and reputable manufacturers, with a robust inventory management system in place to ensure quality and timely restocking. Our store complies with all local zoning, fire, and building codes, operating without any known safety recalls or high-risk activities. We prioritize transparency, maintaining clear customer return and complaint resolution policies, alongside regular safety inspections to uphold a clean and welcoming retail space.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not outsource installation or repair services to unlicensed or uninsured third-party contractors and confirms that all installations and repairs are performed by licensed professionals with adequate insurance coverage. Additionally, we strictly prohibit any improper installation of kitchen appliances or fixtures. Our location also complies with required flood and earthquake insurance mandates due to its position in a flood-prone area.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Home & Hearth Designs LLC, an online retailer specializing in custom kitchen accessories and decor items.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred from a slip and fall incident on 03/15/2023, due to wet flooring in the store, amounting to $1,000. The incident was addressed promptly, and the claimant's medical expenses were covered; currently under review for final settlement.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty fire-rated safe, Class B, UL-listed for high-security storage of cash and valuables.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station alarm system with secure access control and regular door locking protocols.
